title: Joe’s Pub / Sponsorship and genre panels

location.series: Pentagram / The Public Theater case study

slide_intent: Allow a venue to express its range while naming its parent because sub-identities need both autonomy and affiliation.
strategic_value: Lime fields, colored labels and a Public signature can connect a diverse music program to the wider theater.
demonstration: Two tall panels pair sponsor names on lime with a white Joe’s Pub panel of genre labels, performer cutouts and arrows.
practical_value: Compare sponsor recognition and program variety within one shared color treatment.

content_islands.name: Sponsor panel
content_islands.spec: Place sponsor names over oversized white seasonal lettering on lime.

content_islands.name: Venue panel
content_islands.spec: Run JOE’S PUB vertically beside genre labels and figures, closing with the Public mark.
